_comment: Copy this file to config.json next to AutoDoc.exe; it is documentation for humans, no code reads it.
_audio_comment: A device NAME (not a PortAudio index, which shifts when hardware changes); empty means the Windows default input.
_ai_server_comment: AutoDoc talks only to the district's on-premises AI server, so narration and screenshots never leave the network.
_endpoint_comment: Must be port 8080, the metering proxy; 8081 answers requests but bypasses metering.
_model_comment: Must match a model id the server serves (Settings tab -> Fetch); a model with no mmproj projector cannot see screenshots.
_api_key_comment: A metering label, not a secret: a blank value silently attributes AutoDoc's usage to 'chat-ui'.
_screenshot_comment: A render setting, not a capture setting: 'raw' | 'blurred' | 'circled', changeable per session afterwards.
_output_comment: Any subset of md/html/docx; the first entry is what the 'Saved:' dialog offers to open.
_hotkey_comment: pynput GlobalHotKeys syntax, active only while recording; empty string disables one.
_bookstack_comment: When enabled, Generate also publishes a markdown page to bookstack_book; the bot token lives in its own file, not here.
_bookstack_tag_comment: Validated against publish/tags.py's vocabulary; an unrecognised value is dropped, empty string skips the tag.
_theme_comment: 'light' | 'dark'; an unrecognised value falls back to 'light'.
